scope: Deliberately public, source-linked datasets and static APIs published by HECAVEX. Private notes, submissions, credentials, malware samples and quarantined observations are excluded.
publication_policy: Default deny. Only files named in public-manifest.json are staged below /data/.
licence_boundary: HECAVEX-authored software is MIT licensed. Original curated data identified by the data terms is CC BY 4.0. Third-party records, trademarks and source material retain their own terms.

lifecycle_policy.maintained: Actively reviewed on the stated best-effort cadence.
lifecycle_policy.generated from upstream: Rebuilt only after a reviewed upstream release; not independently live-synchronised.
lifecycle_policy.frozen: Kept reproducible at a named version but no longer receives routine additions.
lifecycle_policy.archived: Retained for the record; known stale state is visible and no maintenance is promised.
lifecycle_policy.review_trigger: Review at the stated due date or earlier after a correction, source change, schema change or material related research update.

datasets.name: Baltic Threat Atlas
datasets.archive_condition: Archive or freeze when source coverage or review capacity can no longer support the stated selected-observation scope.
datasets.freshness: The record set exposes a dataset update date; individual observations retain their own dates.
datasets.update_policy: Manual best-effort review when a cited source, correction or related HECAVEX investigation changes.
datasets.scope: Selected public-source cyber observations concerning Lithuania, Latvia and Estonia.
datasets.limitation: Not an exhaustive incident census, prevalence measure or live feed. Source terminology and attribution are preserved.

datasets.name: Evidence Pivot case library
datasets.archive_condition: Freeze an individual case when its released evidence can no longer be reproduced; retain corrections beside the frozen version.
datasets.freshness: The case index exposes its update date and each graph preserves observation and collection times.
datasets.update_policy: A case is reviewed when its released evidence, transformation or analytical boundary changes.
datasets.scope: Published HECAVEX case graphs separating observations, derivations, assessments and limits.
datasets.limitation: Each case is time-bounded. Graph relationships do not establish actor identity beyond the stated evidence.

datasets.name: Enterprise ATT&CK reference catalogue and official procedures
datasets.owner: MITRE ATT&CK upstream / HECAVEX publication build
datasets.review_due: On the next reviewed Enterprise ATT&CK release, no later than 2026-11-20
datasets.archive_condition: Freeze the represented framework version if the generator or upstream terms can no longer be maintained.
datasets.freshness: Framework version and generation date identify the upstream snapshot represented by the files.
datasets.update_policy: Regenerated after a reviewed MITRE Enterprise ATT&CK version update; no real-time synchronization is promised.
datasets.scope: A generated browser-ready subset of active Enterprise ATT&CK techniques, groups and official procedure relationships.
datasets.limitation: MITRE ATT&CK is the authoritative source. These generated files are reference material, not HECAVEX attribution.

datasets.name: HECAVEX-reviewed ATT&CK evidence
datasets.owner: Deividas Lis / HECAVEX and APT Notes
datasets.archive_condition: Archive a relationship when its cited APT Notes evidence is withdrawn or no longer supports the mapping.
datasets.freshness: The dataset update date records the latest reviewed export from published APT Notes evidence.
datasets.update_policy: Rebuilt when a represented APT Notes profile, source relationship or ATT&CK mapping is substantively reviewed.
datasets.scope: Source-linked technique evidence selected from reviewed public APT Notes profiles.
datasets.limitation: A compact publication layer, not a substitute for the cited source and not evidence of defensive coverage.

datasets.name: ATT&CK operational guides, detection packages and governance
datasets.archive_condition: Freeze material whose telemetry assumptions or validation state can no longer be reviewed honestly.
datasets.freshness: Each package carries lifecycle metadata; governance.json exposes review dates, due states and change history.
datasets.update_policy: Reviewed after relevant ATT&CK changes, validation findings or substantive guide and package revisions.
datasets.scope: Product-neutral analyst guidance, engineering candidates, validation templates and publication governance.
datasets.limitation: Not deployable rules and not proof that any environment detects the mapped behaviour.

datasets.name: OSINT Workbench resources
datasets.archive_condition: Remove or archive entries whose service, lawful access boundary or current terms can no longer be verified.
datasets.freshness: The catalogue date records the last manual review, not continuous provider availability monitoring.
datasets.update_policy: Best-effort review after provider changes, corrections or a scheduled curation pass.
datasets.scope: A curated directory of free and free-tier public research resources with use and evidence cautions.
datasets.limitation: Provider access, terms and limits can change; inclusion is not endorsement.

related_datasets.name: APT Notes actor API
related_datasets.freshness_source: The API generated_at field records build time; each actor record carries last_reviewed.
related_datasets.freshness: Static build output with per-record review dates; no continuous update SLA.
related_datasets.update_policy: Republished on a successful APT Notes build after substantive record or source changes.
related_datasets.limitation: Curated research records, not a live IOC feed or exhaustive actor directory.

related_datasets.name: HECAVEX Radar live signals
related_datasets.freshness_source: radar.json generatedAt records signal-snapshot publication time. collection-health.json separately records the latest bounded CertStream attempt, including actual timing, schedule delay, outcome, aggregate counts, last success and freshness.
related_datasets.freshness: Two separate best-effort documents expose snapshot publication freshness and latest-attempt collection health; neither establishes continuous coverage or a complete certificate history.
related_datasets.update_policy: The publisher replaces the snapshot only after schema, safety and sharp-drop checks; there is no continuous-monitoring SLA.
related_datasets.limitation: Potential phishing and impersonation signals are candidates, not maliciousness verdicts; source-specific rights still apply.
